task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.","id":"gh:1409013846","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DS-Bot","slug":"Fei2411/DS-Bot","topics":["bot","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","multi-agent"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DS Bot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DS Bot is an open-source project built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), available as a standalone desktop "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"app or as a DSH plugin. It turns DSH into bots that you create, talk to and work with."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you don't need to install DSH first. Download the installer f"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"or your system from Releases, open it, and set up a model in Settings (it can also copy your existin"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"g bot team from DSH)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"If your system warns about an unsigned app: on Windows select **More info** → **Run anyway**; on mac"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"OS open **System Settings** → **Privacy & Security** and select **Open Anyway**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**As a plugin in DSH**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"First install DSH and set up at least one model in it. DS Bot uses the models from DSH."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **DSH Desktop**: In the sidebar, select **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, enter `ds-bot` (in mainland "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**), then select **Install** and **Enable now**.\n-"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" **DSH Web** (needs Node.js `22.19` or later, and pnpm):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Docker (NAS, Linux server)**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"See `docker/README.md`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Setup"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"I strongly recommend that you set up your other bots and group chats by just talking to a bot."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Web search"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DS Bot selects its `auto` search provider for the whole profile. If you disable `web-search-auto`, a"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lso select another registered search provider in that profile. See Web search and the recovery steps"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"so select another registered search provider in that profile. See Web search and the recovery steps."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Bot"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"You can do all your talking and work with one bot, in one window. You don't need to worry about the "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"context behind it. The bot's details page shows its info, and there you can pick the model and think"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ing level you want it to use. You can switch models at any time, but I still recommend that you keep"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" one model for a bot for a long time, and switch only when you really need to."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Bots also have memory. A bot remembers what you like and uses it in later work. You can manage its m"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"emory on the bot's details page, or just tell the bot."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Each bot can have its own working folder and permission preset — just tell the bot when you want to "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"switch folders. While a bot is working, you can send a message to steer it right away, or type `/sid"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e` to ask a side question without interrupting its task; it can also draw charts, tables and forms i"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"n its replies, or run scheduled tasks. In the sidebar, you can group bots and group chats into colla"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"psible sections by work."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Main bot"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The main bot is your chief. It has very high rights: it manages the other bots and the group chats. "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"The first time you open DS Bot, there is already a main bot called Chief. Talk to it, and it walks y"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ou through the setup."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"In short: have a question? Ask the main bot."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Group chats"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"DS Bot has group chats. A group chat is a great way to get several bots to work together, but it cle"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"arly costs more. So DS Bot does this: every group chat has an admin. The admin answers your messages"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" by default and calls in the other bots for you. You can also @ a bot directly, and it answers you d"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"irectly. To give the bots another chat as context, use + → Reference a chat in the message box."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Any bot can hand work to other bots with @, and those bots do the work on their own and post the res"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ults back to the group. A group chat has its own memory and working folder, invisible to bots outsid"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"e the group. For larger work, a group chat can run a Goal: the admin aligns with you on what \"done\" "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"means, splits the work into stages across members, and checks each stage before moving on."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Private bot"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"If you have private work that you only want to discuss with one bot, turn on Private in its settings"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" and give it a separate working folder. Other bots cannot read its folder, memory or chat history, a"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"nd sending messages to other bots or writing files outside its folder requires your approval. Even i"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"f you delete it, its folder and records stay protected until you release them in Settings."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Note that a private bot cannot be a main bot or join group chats. This boundary only isolates it fro"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"m other bots in your team, not as an OS sandbox: if you give it shell or network access, its command"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"s can still read and write system files or reach the network, and its model provider still receives "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"and write system files or reach the network, and its model provider still receives the conversation."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Local agents"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Coding-agent CLIs you already use on your computer (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor CLI, Devin CLI, O"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"penCode, Gemini CLI and others) can be connected as bots directly. Pick Local agent when creating a "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"bot (or switch in the bot's settings), and it will use the CLI's own sign-in, plan and models while "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"working like any other bot in private chats, group chats, handoffs and memory."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"There are a few limits to keep in mind: a local agent uses the CLI's own tools and context, so share"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"d capabilities and connectors in DS Bot are not passed to it, and switching how a bot runs starts a "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"fresh conversation part; custom CLIs without HTTP MCP support do not get team tools such as creating"},{"id":"p35s4","text":" bots or handing off work. Also, Cursor CLI saves the last selected model as its own global default "},{"id":"p35s5","text":"(`~/.cursor`), so if you pick a specific model for a Cursor bot in DS Bot, other Cursor bots on the "},{"id":"p35s6","text":"default model and Cursor in your terminal will switch to it too — keep \"CLI default\" if you don't wa"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"nt to change your global default (sign in to Cursor first so the model list loads)."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"### Browser"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"### Computer use"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"### IM"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"### Connectors and capabilities"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"In Settings → Connectors, you can sign in to GitHub, Gmail, QQ Mail, 163 and other mailboxes, and re"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"mote MCP servers, or import existing configs from Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. Credentials st"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"ay in DS Bot's secrets so bots never see the raw values, and emails written by a bot wait for your c"},{"id":"p43s4","text":"onfirmation by default."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"In Settings → Capabilities, you can manage shared MCP servers, skills and packs for the team and ena"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"ble them per bot; local commands added by a bot need your approval before they run."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"### Office files"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
